profile.headline: AI Engineer at Robots & Pencils
profile.summary: AI Engineer at Robots & Pencils. I have production experience across the stack, from cloud architecture and frontend, to agentic AI solutions.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer III
positions.description:
- Architected and built agentic AI solutions using Salesforce Agentforce and Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore.
- Extended an existing web frontend to surface the agentic AI system to 10,000+ daily users, driving faster conversion and greater visibility across Yamaha's product portfolio.
- Maintained data pipelines for structured and unstructured data to enable both RAG and information retrieval capabilities.
- Employed DevOps pipelines that included versioning, rollback support, and automated regression testing.
- Combined standard testing with LLM-based grading to ensure agentic systems met behavioral and content-quality standards.
- Contributed to broader frontend development efforts, including feature builds and bug fixes across the web application.
- Tech Stack: AWS (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, Bedrock, AgentCore), Next.js, GitHub Actions.
positions.insights: Agentic AI Development, Next.js and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked as part of a startup development team to build, maintain, and deploy a dating app on the App Store/Google Play Store with over 10,000 monthly users.
- Spearheaded Hatched AI, building a neural network and the data pipelines feeding it, with automated retraining on incoming user data.
- Managed CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, phased rollouts, and rollback procedures in place.
- Developed features across our tech stack from UI to database, including an in-app transaction system.
- Tech Stack: React Native, Firebase/GCP (Auth, Firestore, Functions, Storage), CircleCI.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: - Maintained a web application built using Angular.
